skill.name: brand-guidelines
skill.description: Provides Anthropic brand colors, typography guidance, and styling rules for visual artifacts and presentations.
skill.summary: Use Anthropic brand colors and typography when styling documents, slides, and visual artifacts.
skill.author: Azeem-2

- Light: `#faf9f5` - Light backgrounds and text on dark

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 21 is Markdown inline code around a color value, not Ruby or shell execution. There is no executable context or command invocation.

Line 28 uses Markdown backticks to format the orange accent color value. This is documentation content and cannot execute.
Line 29 formats the blue accent color value with Markdown inline code. No command syntax or executable context is present.

content.value_statement: Inconsistent colors and typography weaken brand alignment across generated artifacts. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code a concise Anthropic style reference.
actual_capabilities: Lists Anthropic brand color values for dark, light, gray, orange, blue, and green.
Defines Poppins for headings and Lora for body text, with fallback fonts.
Explains that headings at 24 points and larger should use Poppins.
Guides non-text shapes to use orange, blue, and green accent colors.
Notes use of python-pptx RGBColor for presentation color matching.
limitations: Does not include executable styling scripts or automated file modification logic.
Requires the assistant or another tool to apply the guidance to artifacts.
Custom fonts must already be installed for best visual results.
Focused on visual styling, not legal approval for brand usage.

use_cases.title: Style Client Presentations
use_cases.description: Apply consistent Anthropic-inspired colors and typography to slides before sharing them.

use_cases.title: Guide Document Formatting
use_cases.description: Use a concise palette and font reference while editing reports, one-pagers, and internal documents.

use_cases.title: Prepare Automation Specs
use_cases.description: Translate brand choices into clear implementation guidance for presentation or document generation workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Apply Basic Styling
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when an artifact needs simple brand alignment.
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the brand-guidelines skill to this artifact. Use the documented colors, typography, and fallback fonts.

prompt_templates.title: Review Visual Consistency
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when checking an existing draft.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this draft against the brand-guidelines skill. Identify color, typography, and shape styling changes needed for consistency.

prompt_templates.title: Create Slide Styling Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a slide styling plan using the brand-guidelines skill. Include heading treatment, body text treatment, and accent color usage.

prompt_templates.title: Specify Implementation Rules
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for advanced automation or handoff work.
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert the brand-guidelines skill into implementation rules for a document workflow. Include font fallbacks, heading thresholds, and color application logic.

output_examples.output: Headings use Poppins with Arial fallback. Body text uses Lora with Georgia fallback. Accent shapes rotate through orange, blue, and green.

output_examples.input: Review a presentation for brand consistency.
output: Use dark text on light backgrounds for readability.
Apply the primary accent color to key shapes.
Keep body copy in the documented body font.

output_examples.input: Prepare guidance for a slide generation workflow.
output_examples.output: Use the documented palette, apply Poppins to large headings, and set presentation colors through the RGB color helper.

best_practices: Use the documented palette consistently across text, backgrounds, and accent shapes.
Confirm font availability before producing final visual artifacts.
Preserve readability when choosing foreground and background color combinations.
anti_patterns: Do not mix unrelated brand palettes with the documented colors.
Do not rely on custom fonts without providing fallback fonts.
Do not apply accent colors randomly when hierarchy or emphasis is needed.

faq.question: What does this skill help style?
faq.answer: It helps style documents, slides, and visual artifacts with Anthropic brand colors and typography guidance.

faq.question: Does it install fonts?
faq.answer: No. It recommends Poppins and Lora, but those fonts must already be available for best results.

faq.question: Can it edit files automatically?
faq.answer: No. The skill provides guidance, and the assistant or another tool must apply the changes.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report marks it as compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it include brand legal approval?
faq.answer: No. It is a visual style reference and does not grant permission to use any protected brand asset.

faq.question: Why does it mention python-pptx?
faq.answer: It notes RGBColor as a way to preserve palette values when formatting presentation files.
